ELKHART, Ind.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--

Patrick Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ: PATK) (“Patrick”) and LCI Industries (NYSE: LCII) (“LCI” or “Lippert”) today announced that their shareholders and stockholders, respectively, have approved the proposals necessary to complete the companies’ previously announced all-stock merger.

“Today marks a significant milestone toward bringing Patrick and Lippert together, and we are grateful for the tremendous support from each company’s shareholders,” said Andy Nemeth, Chief Executive Officer of Patrick. “Our two companies share a deep commitment to our team members, customers and stakeholders, and we believe that together we can deliver more cost-effective, innovative solutions across the Outdoor Enthusiast, Housing and Transportation markets.”

“We appreciate the overwhelming support shown at both meetings today, and we are deeply grateful to the team members who work hard every day in service of our customers,” said Johnny Sirpilla, Interim Chief Executive Officer of Lippert. “For decades, Lippert has earned the trust of customers through innovation, reliability and a culture of service, the same values that have contributed to Patrick’s own growth. We are confident that merging the two companies will extend each company’s legacy in a meaningful way, benefiting team members, shareholders, and the community that we are both proud to call home.”

At the special meeting of Patrick shareholders held today, at least 97% of the votes cast, representing approximately 93% of all outstanding shares, were voted in favor of the four proposals related to the merger. At the special meeting of LCI stockholders held today, approximately 98% of the votes cast, representing approximately 82% of all outstanding shares, were voted in favor of the necessary proposal related to the merger.

The voting results for each special meeting will be reported in Current Reports on Form 8-K to be filed by Patrick and LCI, respectively, with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”). The transaction is expected to close in the first half of 2027 and remains subject to the receipt of required regulatory approvals and the satisfaction or waiver of other customary closing conditions.

Additional information about the transaction is available at patrickandlipperttogether.com.

About Patrick Industries, Inc.

Patrick (NASDAQ: PATK) is a leading component solutions provider serving original equipment manufacturers and aftermarket customers in the RV, Marine, Powersports and Housing markets. Since 1959, Patrick has empowered manufacturers and outdoor enthusiasts to achieve next-level recreation experiences. Our customer-focused approach brings together design, manufacturing, distribution, and transportation in a full solutions model that defines us as a trusted partner. Patrick is home to more than 85 leading brands, all united by a commitment to quality, customer service, and innovation. Headquartered in Elkhart, IN, Patrick employs approximately 10,000 skilled team members throughout the United States. For more information on Patrick, our brands, and products, please visit www.patrickind.com.

About LCI Industries

LCI Industries (NYSE: LCII), through its Lippert subsidiary, is a global leader in supplying engineered components to the outdoor recreation and transportation markets. We believe our innovative culture, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and dedication to enhancing the customer experience have established Lippert as a reliable partner for both OEM and aftermarket customers. First quarter of positive Adjusted EBITDA(1) in several fiscal years, continued cost reductions, and re-affirming revenue guidance of approximately $2.0 million in Q4 2026

Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 18, 2026) - Clear Blue Technologies International Inc. (TSXV: CBLU) (FSE: 0YA0) ("Clear Blue"), the Smart Off-Grid™ Company, announces its unaudited financial results for the third fiscal quarter of 2026 ended September 30, 2026 ("Q3 2026"). A complete set of Financial Statements and Management's Discussion & Analysis ("MD&A") has been filed at www.sedarplus.ca. All dollar amounts are denominated in Canadian dollars.

"The second half of 2026 is beginning to yield the results of our new partnerships and products," said Miriam Tuerk, Co-Founder & CEO of Clear Blue. "In the quarter, the company ramped up its production to meet the increase in sales led by the Eutelsat Konnect Wifi orders. Together with our streamlined organization enabled by AI, cost reductions started to drop to the bottom line and allowed us to deliver a more efficient Q3 with positive Adjusted EBITDA. Our focus in 2027 is to continue leveraging our existing strategic partners and execute on new ones that can give us significant scale to achieve our revenue growth goals."

For the three months ended September 30, 2026 ("Q3 2026"):

  • New bookings were $1,435,566 compared to $745,175 in the corresponding period of 2025, an increase of 93%.
  • Revenue was $1,054,468, an 11% increase from $953,972 in the corresponding previous period.
  • Recurring revenue was $139,005, a 15% decrease from $164,032 in the corresponding previous period.
  • Gross profit increased to $401,681 compared to $352,574 in the comparable period, a 14% increase. The gross margin percentage reflects a sales mix where the current and comparable periods had a higher proportion of hardware deliveries.
  • Non-IFRS Adjusted EBITDA for the period was $214,825 as compared to ($331,032) for the previous period. This was the first positive Adjusted EBITDA quarter in several fiscal years and reflects higher gross profit along with a 24% reduction in operating expenses.
  • Net loss for the period was $144,912 compared to a net loss of $789,438 in the corresponding previous period, an improvement of 82%.
  • Working capital as at September 30, 2026, was $381,043 compared to $222,940 as at December 31, 2025.

Subsequent to the fiscal third quarter:

  • Mr. Nick Blitterswyk joined Clear Blue's Board of Directors as an independent director. Mr. Blitterswyk is the founder and former Chief Executive Officer of UGE International, a formerly TSX Venture Exchange-listed solar energy and battery storage company that was acquired by a US private equity firm in 2024. He has been a longtime advisor to the Company's management, and his public company, capital markets and operating experience will support the Company as it enters its next phase of growth.

Management Commentary & Outlook

In fiscal 2025, the Company launched its "Clear Blue 2.0" business strategy. This strategy is centered around product, customer partnerships, scaling sales volumes, and generating positive Adjusted EBITDA. In its Q2 2026 earnings release, the Company provided guidance of $5 million in revenue for 2026. The Company is pleased to re-affirm its revenue guidance for 2026, resulting in an expected quarterly revenue of approximately $2 million for Q4 2026.

Furthermore, Q3 2026 saw positive Adjusted EBITDA for the first time in several fiscal years, showcasing the Company's continued efforts to increase margins and reduce costs. Q4 2026 is expected to continue the improvements in Adjusted EBITDA due to the higher expected revenue and gross margins in line with historical levels.

Going into fiscal 2027, management's goal is to continue this trajectory by delivering potential year-over-year revenue growth and more consistent, positive Adjusted EBITDA in subsequent quarters. This mandate is supported by the Company's customer demand for its new Pico, Pico+, and Senti products, along with new product launches planned for early 2027.

The Company's commercial and strategic relationship with Eutelsat continued to advance. On September 28, 2026, the Company announced that it had received purchase orders from Eutelsat for 1,000 Pico-Plus Smart Off-Grid power systems to support Eutelsat's continued Konnect Wi-Fi rollout for several countries in Africa. The units are expected to be delivered in Q4 2026, and these orders bring the number of units ordered by Eutelsat in 2026 to approximately 1,500. The orders build on the Letter of Intent signed with Eutelsat on December 17, 2025, for a three-year supply agreement targeting approximately 15,000 Pico-Plus systems, contingent on commercial demand.

Eutelsat is an example of the Company's goal to build long-term commercial relationships that can leverage its standardized products and technologies to provide scale. Clear Blue believes that this will support the Company's long-term growth goals and is in the process of developing other similar initiatives, particularly with its Pico product lines.

For the remainder of the year, Clear Blue is focused on closing the year by hitting its Q4 guidance, positioning itself to close on larger customer orders and converting its pipeline to ensure 2027 is another year of revenue growth.

TEL AVIV, Israel, Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Innoviz Technologies Ltd. (NASDAQ: INVZ) (the "Company", "we", or "Innoviz"), a leading supplier of high-performance, automotive-grade LiDAR sensor platforms for the automotive, security, defense, and industrial markets, today announced that it will effect a reverse share split of its ordinary shares, no par value (the "Ordinary Shares"), at a ratio of 1-for-20 (the "Reverse Share Split"), together with a proportionate reduction of its authorized share capital from 500,000,000 to 25,000,000 Ordinary Shares.

The Reverse Share Split is expected to become effective at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on Friday, December 4, 2026 (the "Effective Time"), and the Ordinary Shares are expected to begin trading on a split-adjusted basis on The Nasdaq Stock Market ("Nasdaq") at market open on Monday, December 7, 2026. The Ordinary Shares will continue to trade under the symbol "INVZ." The new CUSIP number for the Ordinary Shares following the Reverse Share Split will be M5R635 124 (ISIN IL0012498957).

The Company's shareholders approved the Reverse Share Split at the annual general meeting held on September 16, 2026, authorizing a ratio of between 1-for-5 and 1-for-20 to be determined by the Company's board of directors. The Reverse Share Split is intended to increase the per share trading price of the Ordinary Shares so that the Company can regain compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement for continued listing on Nasdaq. There can be no assurance that the Reverse Share Split will have that effect.

Effect on Outstanding Shares

At the Effective Time, every twenty (20) Ordinary Shares issued and outstanding will automatically be combined into one (1) Ordinary Share. The number of outstanding Ordinary Shares will be reduced from approximately 299,546,196 (as of November 17, 2026) to approximately 14,977,309. The Reverse Share Split will affect all shareholders uniformly and will not change any shareholder's percentage ownership interest, except for the treatment of fractional shares described below.

Fractional Shares

No fractional Ordinary Shares will be issued in connection with the Reverse Share Split. Shareholders who would otherwise be entitled to a fractional share will instead receive a cash payment, without interest and subject to applicable withholding taxes, equal to such fraction multiplied by the closing price of the Ordinary Shares on Nasdaq on December 4, 2026, the trading day immediately preceding the Effective Time (as adjusted to give effect to the Reverse Share Split). Shareholders holding fewer than twenty (20) Ordinary Shares immediately before the Effective Time will receive only cash and will no longer hold Ordinary Shares.

Shareholder Action

Equiniti Trust Company, LLC, the Company's transfer agent, will act as exchange agent. Shareholders holding Ordinary Shares in book-entry form with the transfer agent do not need to take any action; their holdings will be adjusted automatically and any cash payment will be sent to them. Shareholders holding Ordinary Shares through a broker, bank or other nominee do not need to take any action; their accounts will be adjusted, and any cash payment credited, under the nominee's procedures, which may differ from those described above.

Equity Awards and Warrants

Proportionate adjustments will be made to the number of Ordinary Shares issuable under the Company's equity incentive plans and outstanding equity awards, and to the number of Ordinary Shares issuable upon exercise of, and the exercise price of, the Company's outstanding warrants, in each case in accordance with their terms.

Tax Considerations

For a summary of certain U.S. federal income tax and Israeli tax considerations of the Reverse Share Split, including the receipt of cash in lieu of fractional shares, see Exhibit 99.2 to the Company's Report on Form 6-K furnished to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on November 18, 2026, together with the Company's proxy statement for the annual general meeting held on September 16, 2026. Shareholders are urged to consult their tax advisors with respect to the particular tax consequences of the Reverse Share Split.

About Innoviz
Innoviz is a leading provider of LiDAR technology, serving as a Tier-1 supplier to the world's leading automotive manufacturers while extending its existing sensing solutions into defense, homeland security, industrial, and smart infrastructure markets.

Innoviz's LiDAR sensors and complementary software suite are designed to deliver exceptional range, resolution, and reliability, providing accurate 3D sensing even in harsh weather conditions. Built to meet the automotive industry's strict standards for performance and safety, Innoviz's sensors are increasingly supplied for applications that demand precise, real-time spatial awareness and continuous object localization.

Operating across the U.S., Europe, and Asia, Innoviz designs solutions for automotive OEMs, system integrators, municipalities, commercial enterprises, government organizations, and other customers worldwide. THE WOODLANDS, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Perma-Pipe International Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: PPIH), a global leader in engineered piping and corrosion protection solutions, today announced $37 million in additional new orders during the third quarter ended October 31, 2026. Together with the approximate $28 million in new orders reported in the Company October 20, 2026 update, third quarter total new orders total approximately $65 million.

Most of the additional new orders came from the MENA region, where demand for specialized pipeline solutions is supported by ongoing investments in oil and gas infrastructure and major energy-related projects, with the balance from North America. The additional bookings follow the Company's October 20, 2026 announcement of approximately $28 million in third-quarter bookings and reflect continued commercial momentum across its Middle East and North Africa (MENA) and North American (NA) regions.

In particular, MENA continues to represent an important growth market for Perma-Pipe. The Company's established regional presence, technical expertise, manufacturing capabilities and long-standing relationships with major customers and contractors position it to capitalize on opportunities arising from the region's ongoing energy infrastructure development. The Company's North American operations also contributed to the additional bookings, reinforcing the benefits of its geographical diversification and continued focus on expanding its presence across key markets.

The joint venture will focus on internal fusion-bonded epoxy (IFBE) coating and related activities in India. This acquisition expands Perma-Pipe's specialized coating capabilities and provides a platform to pursue opportunities in India's domestic market and international export markets, serving the oil and gas, water and industrial infrastructure sectors.

This partnership combines Perma-Pipe's specialized coating expertise with Welspun's established industrial presence in India, expanding our capabilities and providing an important platform to pursue opportunities in India and international markets.

TOKYO, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- MEDIROM Healthcare Technologies Inc. (Nasdaq: MRM) (the “Company”) today announced that on November 13, 2026, it received a notice (the “Notice”) from the Listing Qualifications Department of The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC (“Nasdaq”) because the Company had not filed its Annual Report on Form 20-F for the year ended December 31, 2025 (the “Annual Report”) within the extension period previously granted by Nasdaq and therefore had not regained compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1).

As previously disclosed, Nasdaq notified the Company on May 26, 2026, that it was not in compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) because it had not timely filed the Annual Report. Nasdaq subsequently granted the Company an extension to regain compliance. The Company did not file the Annual Report within that extension period. The Notice stated that unless the Company requests an appeal of the delisting determination, trading of the Company’s American Depositary Shares will be subject to suspension and delisting from Nasdaq at the opening of business on November 24, 2026.

On November 18, 2026, the Company timely submitted a request for a hearing before a Nasdaq Hearings Panel (the “Panel”) to appeal the determination. Under the applicable Nasdaq rules, the hearing request automatically stays any suspension of trading in the Company’s American Depositary Shares (“ADSs”) for 15 days from the date of the request. The Notice also stated that when the Company requests a hearing, it may also request a stay of the suspension pending the hearing. The Company has requested an extended stay of any trading suspension pending completion of the hearing process.

The Company filed the Annual Report with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on November 18, 2026. The Company has presented the filing of the Annual Report to Nasdaq in support of its appeal and request for continued listing. There can be no assurance that Nasdaq will determine that the filing resolves the Company’s periodic reporting deficiency or results in the cancelation of a hearing, that the Panel will grant any further stay of suspension or the Company’s request for continued listing, or that the Company will regain or maintain compliance with all applicable Nasdaq continued listing requirements.

The Notice relates to the Company’s periodic reporting deficiency. Separately, as previously disclosed, on October 6, 2026, the Company received a notice that it was not in compliance with the minimum bid price requirement under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). Nasdaq provided the Company until April 5, 2027, to regain compliance with that requirement. Filing the Annual Report does not resolve this separate minimum bid price deficiency.

Forward-Looking Statements
This press release contains forward-looking statements within the meaning of applicable U.S. securities laws, including statements regarding the Company’s appeal of the determination, any further stay of trading suspension, continued listing of the Company’s ADSs, and the Company’s ability to regain or maintain compliance with Nasdaq’s continued listing requirements. These statements are based on current expectations and are subject to risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially, including Nasdaq’s response in light of the filing of the Annual Report, the outcome of any hearing process, the Panel’s exercise of discretion, the Company’s ability to satisfy applicable listing requirements, and the other risks described in the Company’s Annual Report on Form 20-F for the year ended December 31, 2025 and its other filings with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. Forward-looking statements speak only as of the date of this release. Except as required by law, the Company undertakes no obligation to update these statements.

About MEDIROM Group
MEDIROM Group operates approximately 281 wellness salons under the “Re.Ra.Ku®” brand nationwide. Since 2015, we have expanded into HealthTech, offering on-demand training apps like Lav® for specific health guidance and lifestyle improvement programs. In 2020, we started manufacturing the 24/7 recharge-free smart tracker “MOTHER Bracelet®,” which is now used in REMONY, our remote monitoring system for various industries including caregiving, transportation, construction, and manufacturing.

WILMINGTON, Del., Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Chemours Company ("Chemours" or "the Company") (NYSE: CC), a global chemistry company with leading market positions in Thermal & Specialized Solutions ("TSS"), Titanium Technologies ("TT"), and Advanced Performance Materials ("APM"), today announced that Kristine Wellman, Senior Vice President, General Counsel & Corporate Secretary, will retire from Chemours. Concurrent with this change, effective January 4, 2027, Amy Rocklin will join Chemours to serve as Senior Vice President, General Counsel & Corporate Secretary. As part of her transition, effective January 4, 2027, Wellman will move into the role of SVP, Senior Counsel to President and Chief Executive Officer Denise Dignam, where she will continue to provide counsel and support to the Company until May 2027.

Wellman joined Chemours in 2014 and has made significant contributions to the Company through a diverse range of leadership roles spanning legal, strategic planning, sustainability and manufacturing operations. She was part of the legal leadership team that helped stand up Chemours as an independent public company and today leads a global team of legal, corporate governance, enterprise risk, compliance, security, sustainability and government affairs professionals.

"Kristine has been an extraordinary leader, colleague and trusted advisor, and her impact on Chemours extends well beyond the legal function," said Denise Dignam, President and Chief Executive Officer of Chemours. "Her breadth of experience, sound judgment and unwavering commitment to integrity have helped shape our company from its earliest days. I am deeply grateful for Kristine's partnership and many contributions to Chemours, and I am pleased that we will continue to benefit from her experience and counsel during this transition."

Rocklin joins Chemours with more than two decades of legal, business and scientific experience in complex, technology-driven industries. Most recently, she served as Chief Legal & Administrative Officer and Corporate Secretary at Neogen Corporation, where she led global Legal and Compliance and enterprise risk, advised the Board of Directors, and held leadership responsibility for regulatory affairs, quality, government and industry affairs, and sustainability. Prior to Neogen, Rocklin spent nearly 10 years at Corning Incorporated, ultimately serving as Vice President, Corporate Law. She holds a Juris Doctor from The George Washington University Law School and a Ph.D. in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology and Biophysics from the University of Minnesota.

"Amy brings a powerful combination of legal expertise, business acumen and scientific and technical understanding to Chemours," said Dignam. "She has spent her career working at the intersection of law, science, technology and business and understands what it takes to lead in highly regulated global industries. Her experience advising boards and executive teams and navigating complex business and regulatory matters will make her a strong addition to our leadership team. We are excited to welcome Amy and look forward to her leadership and contributions as we execute our Pathway to Thrive strategy and position Chemours for long-term success."

About The Chemours Company
The Chemours Company (NYSE: CC) is a global leader in providing industrial and specialty chemicals products for markets, including coatings, plastics, refrigeration and air conditioning, transportation, semiconductor and advanced electronics, general industrial, and oil and gas. Through our three businesses – Thermal & Specialized Solutions, Titanium Technologies, and Advanced Performance Materials – we deliver application expertise and chemistry-based innovations that solve customers' biggest challenges. Our flagship products are sold under prominent brands such as Opteon™, Freon™, Ti-Pure™, Nafion™, Teflon™, Viton™, and Krytox™. Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware and listed on the NYSE under the symbol CC, Chemours has approximately 5,700 employees and 28 manufacturing sites and serves approximately 2,400 customers in approximately 110 countries. For more information, visit chemours.com or follow us on LinkedIn.

Revenue increased by $0.5 million, or 19%, compared to the same period last year. The increase reflects greater tipping fee revenue from higher volumes at the organic waste and composting facilities and stronger RNG output at the Fraser Valley Biogas (“FVB”) and Grow the Energy Circle (“GrowTEC”) facilities.

The net loss decreased by $0.4 million, or 40%, compared to the same period last year, driven by revenue growth, absence of loss on sale of assets, partially offset by higher general and administrative expenses.

Adjusted EBITDA increased by $0.5 million, or 99%, year over year, supported by higher tipping volumes at the organic waste and composting facilities and greater RNG production and related revenue at FVB and GrowTEC.

RNG output reached 56,064 GJ, an increase of 8% over Q3 2025, as the FVB and GrowTEC RNG facilities continued to operate at more stable levels.

Subsequent Events

Subsequent to quarter-end, Farm Credit Canada (“FCC”) expanded its existing project-level credit facility at the Company’s Fraser Valley Biogas facility by $0.8 million. The additional funding will finance near-term optimization at FVB, with the replacement of the facility’s thermal oxidizer, a part of the biogas upgrading process, with a new, more energy-efficient unit.

The upgrade has a total estimated capital cost of approximately $1.4 million, to be funded by a combination of proceeds from this FCC facility increase and operating cash flow. EverGen anticipates partially offsetting these costs by applying for rebates under FortisBC’s Custom Efficiency Program once the upgrade is complete and the actual energy savings are confirmed. The new unit is targeted to be operational by mid-2027. With FVB and GrowTEC continuing to set new RNG production records, the upgrade is expected to further improve efficiency at FVB and support stronger cash flow from EverGen’s core operating assets.

Management Commentary

“Our third-quarter results show our operating improvements continuing to pay off, with higher RNG output and growing feedstock volumes,” said Chase Edgelow, Co-founder and CEO of EverGen.

“With our core assets performing steadily and the Pacific Coast Renewables RNG expansion progressing towards a final investment decision, we remain focused on disciplined capital allocation and accretive growth across both our existing development pipeline and selective inorganic opportunities.

“The increased FCC facility supports a short-payback optimization project at FVB that we expect will improve energy efficiency and cash generation once complete. Pairing low-cost, non-dilutive project-level debt with available grants and incentives is a repeatable playbook we can apply to growth and optimization across the portfolio.”

Complete details of the quarter’s results are available in the Company’s Consolidated Financial Statements and Management’s Discussion and Analysis, which can be found on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.ca and on the EverGen website at www.evergeninfra.com.

Non-GAAP Measures

EverGen uses certain financial measures referred to in this press release to quantify its results that are not prescribed by IFRS Accounting Standards. The terms EBITDA, adjusted EBITDA and working capital are not recognized measures under IFRS Accounting Standards and may not be comparable to that reported by other companies. EverGen believes that, in addition to measures prepared in accordance with IFRS Accounting Standards, the non-GAAP measurement provides useful information to evaluate the Company’s performance and ability to generate cash, profitability and meet financial commitments. These non-GAAP measures are intended to provide additional information and should not be considered in isolation or as a substitute for other measures of performance prepared in accordance with IFRS Accounting Standards. EBITDA is defined as net income (loss) before interest, tax and depreciation and amortization. Adjusted EBITDA is EBITDA adjusted for share-based payment expenses, certain non-cash items, unusual or non-recurring items, contingent consideration gains and losses and non-controlling interests in adjusted EBITDA. Working capital is calculated as current assets less current liabilities.
